scenario: signed-out setup with a project, confirmed on the App's own sheet
what_it_is: Agent-operated development evidence on an identified development build: first-use setup with an invented project folder and new settings, confirmed by an agent's one press on the App's own native confirmation sheet after the sheet is checked whole. It needs no sign-in and makes no conversation. It is not a person's observation and meets no criterion.
starting_state: An identified candidate built from main, without the driver's markers; a kept home made by the launcher with its network blocks on; the invented project folder beside the home, empty; no App data; the App running and confirmed from the shell; no child process.
acts: views, clicks, one set-value of the project path into the field Project folder (typed because the alternative is the system's folder panel, which no agent operates), and one press on the App's own setup confirmation sheet; no file or folder is chosen and no other sheet, dialog or prompt is answered
window_holds: full screen button Help: this button also has an action to zoom the window, Secondary Actions: zoom the window
